# McDonald's Party Officer

A party decision system for McDonald's China stores, built on the official party tools of the McDonald's China MCP. It scans party sessions across a city (store, date, session, seats left), scores them, and answers four questions: which session is most likely to reach its group size (formation probability radar), whether private hire or group buy is cheaper and safer (cost comparison of both modes), which coming date is best (a party almanac scoring dates against the official campaign calendar, weekends and seats), and whether a kids menu stays within stated reference limits (a nutrition audit with swap suggestions). It also makes a group recruit card, a shareable HTML invitation and a T minus 7 planning timeline. Official rules it must repeat: private hire starts at 5 people, group buy needs more than 5, each session caps at 12, sessions last about 90 minutes, booking is 3 days ahead, and an unformed group booking is automatically cancelled and refunded.
